items.approved_script: Search Natural Rems Sea Moss on Amazon. Or tap my profile picture, the link is waiting in my stories, or right there in my bio.
The one I trust is Natural Rems Sea Moss. Wild Irish sea moss, apple, apple cider vinegar, ginger and dandelion, sixteen in one gummy.
So on busy days, baby, I reach for what my grandmother gave me back in Kingston, sea moss. It feeds that same gut.
